Its chemical structure is mostly long chains of carbon and hydrogen atoms with very little oxygen. That structure packs more usable energy into a smaller space. Carbohydrates and proteins contain more oxygen atoms in their molecular structure. Oxygen atoms add weight without adding the same amount of burnable energy. When your body breaks down these nutrients, the energy released per gram is lower. This is chemistry, not opinion.
